Coram : ASHOK BHUSHAN*, K.M. JOSEPH
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: s.482 – Application under – By six appellants-accused – Praying for quashing the complaint and criminal proceedings in a complaint case u/ss. 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and s.3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act – Application dismissed by High to Supreme Court – Held: There were two sets of allegations in the complaint – One was with regard to offences u/ss. 323, 504 and 506 IPC and another for offences u/s. 498A IPC and ss. 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act – Complaint u/ss. 323, 504 and 506 was made only against one
Decision Date : 30-04-2019 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 594/2019 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
